experiment_data.hypothesis: SDF gradient-guided action refinement during training (A3) improves collision avoidance on spatial_bowl Level II — training with lambda_refine SDF gradient loss teaches the model to generate actions that respect obstacle geometry, expecting CAR improvement over baseline with TSR drop <10%. Directly comparable to AEGIS (CAR 86%, TSR 88%) on same task.
